workflows.title: Overview dashboard
acceptance: The deployed dashboard loads without a redirect or fallback fixture.
KPIs and urgent failure signals agree with the underlying UAT records after reload.

workflows.title: Test library, domain, work item, and case
acceptance: An owner can traverse domain, work-item, and case detail from the library.
Reload preserves the PostgreSQL-backed hierarchy and current case version.

workflows.title: Case reorder and cross-work-item move
acceptance: A case can be reordered inside its work item and moved to another work item by drag and drop.
Cancel/no-drop leaves order unchanged and a successful drop remains after reload with an audit event.

workflows.title: Create, cancel, and save
acceptance: Cancel returns to the originating list without saving a draft or leaving the form in browser history.
A valid case save creates one durable case and later edits create a new durable version.

workflows.title: Cycle creation and lifecycle
acceptance: A work-item or label scoped cycle previews the intended cases, creates once, and pins case versions.
Results are disabled before start, enabled in progress, read-only after completion, and available again after reopen.

workflows.title: Per-step, per-platform execution
acceptance: WEB, AOS, and iOS results are stored independently for every selected step.
FAIL and BLOCKED notes persist, aggregation follows the documented policy, and reload does not lose attempts.

workflows.title: Issues and private attachments
acceptance: An issue created from an execution keeps its attempt/step link and history.
Two real files selected in one chooser event can each be uploaded, previewed or downloaded, and deleted through the private storage flow.

workflows.title: Deleted, restore, permanent-delete, and permission boundary
acceptance: Cases, cycles, and issues are discoverable only in the intended active/deleted views and can be restored.
Permanent delete is soft-delete-state and exact-confirmation gated; the owner records the current VPN/no-login trust boundary and does not claim application RBAC.

workflows.title: Reports
acceptance: Cycle filters and counts agree between Reports, Dashboard, and selected cycle details.
Blocked and unexecuted results are represented according to the documented aggregation policy.

workflows.title: Slack work items
acceptance: An allowlisted UAT root and its thread/revisions are visible with source provenance.
Disallowed-channel content is absent and no secret, signature, or raw credential is rendered.

workflows.title: Knowledge
acceptance: Knowledge search/detail shows source evidence and the authoritative status.
AMBIGUOUS, SUPERSEDED, RETRACTED, and expired knowledge is not presented as active generation grounding.

workflows.title: Integrations
acceptance: Slack and object-storage state is visible without exposing credential values.
Private R2, fail-closed scanning, limits, and setup/degraded states are accurately presented.

workflows.title: Automatic-generation failure safe states
acceptance: Failure queue/detail shows bounded safe codes, append-only attempts, and correct actionability.
Raw provider responses and secrets are absent; retry is unavailable when the failure policy forbids it.

workflows.title: Automatic-generation quality-review safe states
acceptance: The page always shows CANDIDATE and UNREVIEWED or REVIEWED_NOT_RELEASE_CERTIFIED boundaries.
Reviewer tokens remain memory-only and missing attestations never appear as release certification.

workflows.title: 390px mobile owner checks
acceptance: At a 390px viewport, primary navigation, list/detail, forms, execution, dialogs, and safe-state banners remain usable.
No required action, confirmation, result cell, or evidence boundary is clipped or reachable only by hover.

manualChecks.title: Dashboard data and reload
steps: Open the exact-origin dashboard and record the visible KPIs and urgent signals.
Compare them with the selected cycle, issue, and report UAT records, then hard reload and confirm no fixture or stale values appear.

manualChecks.title: Domain to work item to case traversal
steps: Expand a UAT domain, open a work item, and open a case from that work item.
Record identifiers and current versions, hard reload each detail, and confirm the same PostgreSQL-backed records remain.

manualChecks.title: Drag reorder, move, and cancel
steps: Drag a UAT case but cancel or drop outside a valid target and verify no order or parent change.
Reorder it inside its work item, then move it to a second work item; hard reload and verify the final parent/order and audit event.
Move the disposable UAT case back if the approved scenario requires cleanup.

manualChecks.title: Case create cancellation and durable save
steps: Enter a recognizable disposable draft, cancel it, use browser back, and verify the form and draft are not resurrected or saved.
Create one valid per-step case, reload its detail, edit and save it, then verify a new version and audit event without a duplicate case.

manualChecks.title: Cycle scope, start, complete, and reopen
steps: Preview and create a disposable work-item or label scoped cycle and record the pinned case versions.
Confirm result entry is disabled while PLANNED, start once, complete after execution, confirm read-only state, and reopen once.
Verify original library case edits do not change the pinned cycle snapshot.

manualChecks.title: Per-step and per-platform results
steps: For a multi-step UAT case, save distinct WEB, AOS, and iOS results at the step level, including one FAIL and one BLOCKED note.
Reload and verify every step/platform receipt and note, then compare case/cycle aggregation with the documented PASS/FAIL denominator rules.

manualChecks.title: Issue linkage and private multi-file attachments
steps: Create an issue from the selected execution step and verify precondition, reproduction, expected/actual result, and attempt linkage.
In one physical-browser chooser event select two approved non-sensitive files; verify each upload completes CLEAN, each preview/download matches, and each delete removes access.
Confirm no public object URL or storage credential appears in UI evidence.

manualChecks.title: Soft delete, restore, permanent delete, and access boundary
steps: For disposable UAT case, cycle, and issue records, verify active/deleted list separation, soft delete, and restore.

Verify permanent delete is unavailable before soft delete, requires the exact visible confirmation after soft delete, preserves the security audit reference, and makes the disposable record unrecoverable.
Record the allowed VPN/internal tester boundary and the product's current no-login/no-application-RBAC limitation; do not report role enforcement that does not exist.

manualChecks.title: Report and dashboard reconciliation
steps: Apply a cycle filter in Reports and compare case count, platform slots, status totals, and issue severities with the cycle detail and Dashboard.
Confirm UNEXECUTED and BLOCKED are represented according to the documented aggregation policy.

manualChecks.title: Slack root, thread, revision, and allowlist
manualChecks.ownerRole: QA owner and Slack integration owner
steps: Using an approved UAT Slack sample, verify the root, thread replies, permalink/source fields, and edit/delete revisions are visible in order.
Verify an allowlist-excluded sample is absent and rendered data contains no signature, bearer token, or credential.
Record external Slack live-connection evidence separately; synthetic repository evidence is not a substitute.

manualChecks.title: Knowledge evidence and inactive-state exclusion
steps: Open an ACTIVE knowledge result and verify its cited Slack/test/execution/issue evidence and status history.
Search an approved AMBIGUOUS, SUPERSEDED, RETRACTED, or expired sample and verify it is not presented as active grounding.
Record whether the sample uses approved real anonymized data or remains synthetic.

manualChecks.title: Slack and object-storage safe integration state
steps: Verify Slack connection/callback/allowlist state and private-default-deny representation without credential values.
Verify R2 reports READY, PRIVATE, PRESIGNED_PUT, BACKEND_PROXY, FAIL_CLOSED_CLAMAV, the exact approved bucket, and expected file limit.
Record any degraded/setup-required state as FAIL rather than overriding it for UAT.

manualChecks.title: Automatic-generation failure safe states
steps: Open an approved terminal-failure UAT record and verify safe error code, finality, actionability, attempts, and append-only history.
Verify raw provider response, request secret, and credential values are absent and retry controls appear only when policy allows.
If an operator retry is approved for this UAT, record it as a separate manual mutation artifact; the collector never performs it.

manualChecks.title: Quality-review candidate and non-certification boundaries
steps: Verify the candidate page always displays CANDIDATE with UNREVIEWED or REVIEWED_NOT_RELEASE_CERTIFIED and never implies release approval.
Verify reviewer tokens are absent from localStorage, sessionStorage, URL, logs, and evidence; use only approved UAT reviewer actions.
Verify missing provider-live or actual-sample attestation remains NOT_RUN and that two distinct reviewer authorities are required for REVIEWED.

manualChecks.title: 390px mobile critical-flow inspection
steps: At an exact 390 CSS-pixel viewport, inspect dashboard, library/detail/create, cycle/detail/execution, issue/detail/create, reports, Slack, generation safe states, knowledge, and integrations.

Use keyboard/touch-equivalent navigation and verify primary actions, dialogs, confirmation inputs, step/platform result cells, and evidence boundary banners are visible without hover-only access or destructive clipping.
Record viewport/browser identity and one screenshot set or video covering every named surface.
